title: Find the full name and hometown city of the member who incurred the highest
question: Find the full name and hometown city of the member who incurred the highest total expense across multiple events that were budgeted for 'Food', where each individual expense was under $50.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T5."XCL_045"
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_022"
INNER JOIN budget AS T3 ON T2."XCL_023" = T3."XCL_003"
INNER JOIN event AS T4 ON T3."XCL_009" = T4."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T5 ON T1."XCL_041" = T5."XCL_043"
WHERE T3."XCL_004" = 'Food' AND T2."XCL_020" < 50
GROUP BY T1."XCL_034", T1."XCL_035", T1."XCL_036", T5."XCL_045"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T4."XCL_010") > 1
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_020") DESC
LIMIT 1
